title: Popliteofibular Ligament
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Conventional teaching gives it a length of about 10 mm, which makes it short, thick and obliquely placed rather than a long cord.
Conventional teaching puts it within about 2 cm of the styloid, which makes every fibular fixation a fixation near a nerve.
Sectioning studies make it the largest single contributor to external rotation restraint at 30 degrees of flexion, ahead of the popliteus tendon and the collateral ligament.
